title: Improving Instruction Hierarchy by Learning from Goal-Goal Conflicts
abstract: arXiv:2610.35093v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The recent incident in which OpenAI agents autonomously compromised Hugging Face's infrastructure illustrates the importance of instruction hierarchy (IH): an LLM should follow lower-priority instructions, such as user requests, only when they do not conflict with higher-priority instructions, such as system policies. IH can be effectively improved by fine-tuning LLMs on simulated examples of instruction conflicts, whose diversity is key to teaching LLMs to properly handle conflicts at test time. However, our decomposition of a task into goals and constraints reveals a conflict type -- goal-goal conflicts -- that is absent from existing IH training sets from OpenAI and NVIDIA. translated_title: 通过从目标-目标冲突中学习来改进指令层级
translated_abstract: 最近OpenAI智能体自主入侵Hugging Face基础设施的事件说明了指令层级（Instruction Hierarchy, IH）的重要性：大语言模型只有在低优先级指令（如用户请求）不与高优先级指令（如系统策略）发生冲突时，才应遵循低优先级指令。通过在模拟的指令冲突样例上对LLM进行微调，可以有效改进指令层级，而这些样例的多样性是教会LLM在测试时正确处理冲突的关键。然而，我们将任务分解为目标和约束后发现了一种冲突类型——目标-目标冲突——这种冲突类型在OpenAI和NVIDIA现有的指令层级训练集中是缺失的。我们展示了这种冲突类型的重要性：在目标-目标冲突样例上微调Qwen3.5-9B和Gemma4-12B-it，能够显著提升模型在训练中未见的广泛真实世界任务上的指令层级表现；将这些样例添加到现有的指令层级训练集中进行微调……
tldr: 本文通过任务的目标-约束分解发现现有指令层级训练集中缺失“目标-目标冲突”这一冲突类型，并证明在该类冲突样例上微调LLM可显著提升模型在未见过的大量真实任务上的指令层级表现。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "goal-goal conflicts" as a conflict type absent from existing instruction hierarchy training sets and shows that fine-tuning LLMs on such examples significantly improves instruction hierarchy across a wide range of unseen real-world tasks.
